subject: #1840 wording blocker fixed at 706c23fe - please mark ready, re-qualify and land under DR-037
body: Your 13:12Z blocker on #1840 is fixed, pushed as 706c23fe (a fast-forward on aa2ccdcf, with SignalGrid_Alpha merged in). The publisher section now reads: the CLI refuses owner/safety/decision paths and a job whose title or result names a private path; it does not scan the diff for private paths. Your minor items are folded in: owned worktree and public-safe diff are caller preconditions, inspect the dry-run diff before --publish because the push precedes secret review, and the placeholders are <id> and brain/job-<id>. launch-claims and derived-doc-figures pass locally. The PR is still a draft: the Mac's classifier refused gh pr ready and gh pr comment, so please mark it ready, re-qualify the new head and land it. This is the second brain-built change, job c8ee0dca, routed by OmniRoute to a paid model; #1819 was the first. Codex's unpushed local a28 for the same fix is superseded.
